The '''81st Infantry Battalion''' was a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Imperial soldier]]s serving the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Army]]. It fought in the [[Battle of Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]] in [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="Fall of Corellia" />
